run_simfinger_demo: run the trifinger simulation demo that moves finger tips back and forth using inverse kinematics
create_simfinger_instance: create a SimFinger instance with trifingerpro type and visualization enabled for simulation
compute_forward_kinematics: compute forward kinematics to get fingertip positions from initial joint angle values
compute_inverse_kinematics: compute inverse kinematics to get joint positions from desired fingertip target positions
step_simulation_with_action: append a desired finger action and get the observation to step the simulation forward
